title: Trump fumes at ‘stain’ on Norway after missing out on Nobel Peace Prize
description: The president described the decision to award the Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay as “disgraceful and embarrassing” and said he would “not forget.”

title: Montana Democrat who refuses to drop out may spoil party’s Senate hopes
description: Candidate Alani Bankhead vigorously denies claims she is a Republican plant running to take votes away from a more popular independent.

title: Darline Graham opposes Chinese manufacturing. Her husband’s employers rely on it.
description: The senator and sister of the late Lindsey Graham has said the U.S. must “stop depending on Communist China for things America can make ourselves.”

title: These lawmakers want to head off a potential post-election crisis
description: A bipartisan effort is underway in Congress to avert a constitutional crisis, where Republicans don't seat Democrats, if they win the chamber.

title: Why former Republican governors are backing a Democrat for Senate in a red state
description: Adam Hamilton, the Democratic Senate candidate in Kansas, is running as a centrist rather than a hyper-partisan and needs Republican votes to win the race.

title: U.S. imposes sweeping sanctions on International Criminal Court
description: The U.S. has announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio vowing to dismantle the world's only permanent war crimes tribunal.

title: Week in Politics: Hegseth's livestream backlash; Greece ambassador Guilfoyle scandal
description: Bipartisan blowback on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plans to livestream a military execution, plus a scandal involving Kimberly Guilfoyle, the US Ambassador to Greece.

title: On the ground in Ohio's 9th District: The battleground shaping next month's midterms
description: Ohio is a critical battleground in next month's midterms elections. NPR's Scott Simon traveled to the state's 9th Congressional District to hear from voters about their priorities.

title: After losing ground with Latino voters, Democrats are turning to influencers for help
description: Democrats are hoping to win back Latino voters who have soured on both parties. They hope Latino content creators will bridge the gap.

description: Trump bet that his presence could turn out conservative Republicans in the gubernatorial race. But even some in the MAGA base aren’t confident about the odds.

title: Texas Senate nominee James Talarico reappears after multi-day absence
description: The Democrat’s campaign said he was recovering from the flu, while Republicans tried to make his absence seem suspicious.

title: D.C. judge bars DOJ from gathering states’ voter lists to find noncitizens
description: Voting rights groups had challenged the effort, noting federal data includes errors that have led to citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

description: Katie Zacharia replaces Karoline Leavitt, who departed the White House in August after giving birth to her second child.

description: The matchup will test the strength of the Democratic Party’s progressive wing — and the congresswoman’s potential 2028 chances — in a battleground state.

description: Polling and the work of prognosticators like the Cook Political Report suggest Democrats are likely to take back the House in November.

title: Trump is trying last-minute ways to bring down prices
description: What happened under the Trump administration this week that you may have missed.

description: A commission that will report to the president will assess the mortgage fraud allegations against her and consider evidence from a hearing next month.

title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
description: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

description: Polls show Trump losing support among his base and voters focused on Senate control and issues.

title: As pro-Trump rulings boost Justice Alito’s stature, retirement speculation swirls
description: Samuel A. Alito Jr., who has often been in the shadow of other conservative justices, has taken on new prominence as a champion for the president’s policies.

description: Amid concerns that political insiders might use privileged knowledge to make money, there’s a new wave of efforts to regulate the platforms.

title: Democrat has edge over Susan Collins in critical Maine Senate battle, poll finds
description: Likely voters prefer Jackson on several key issues, but they favor Collins’s ability to steer federal dollars to the state.

description: The U.S. population is about 20 percent Hispanic and Latino.
